name: Vaal Armourer's Infuser
effect: Improves the quality of an Armour, exceeding maximum quality by up to 10% with a chance of Corrupting it
usage: Right click this item then left click an armour to apply it. Can only be used on items at or above maximum quality.
description: Improves the quality of an Armour, exceeding maximum quality by up to 10% with a chance of Corrupting it

beginner.whatItIs: A stackable currency that raises armour quality up to ten percent beyond the cap, with a chance to corrupt the piece.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra quality is applied to the armour's own defensive numbers, so on a large chest piece it is a meaningful block of defence.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on an armour piece already at maximum quality that you are willing to risk. It stacks to ten.

name: Vaal Blacksmith's Infuser
effect: Improves the quality of a Martial Weapon, exceeding maximum quality by up to 10% with a chance of Corrupting it
usage: Right click this item then left click a martial weapon to apply it. Can only be used on items at or above maximum quality.
description: Improves the quality of a Martial Weapon, exceeding maximum quality by up to 10% with a chance of Corrupting it

beginner.whatItIs: A stackable currency that raises a martial weapon past its quality cap by up to ten percent, with a chance of corrupting it.
beginner.whyItMatters: Weapon quality multiplies damage, so overcapping a weapon is one of the larger single upgrades available to a finished build.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Reserve it for a weapon at maximum quality that you do not intend to craft on any further.

name: Vaal Catalysing Infuser
effect: Improves the quality of a ring or amulet, exceeding maximum quality by up to 10% with a chance of Corrupting it
usage: Right click this item then left click a ring or amulet to apply it. Can only be used on items at or above maximum quality.
description: Improves the quality of a ring or amulet, exceeding maximum quality by up to 10% with a chance of Corrupting it

beginner.whatItIs: A stackable currency that pushes a ring or amulet up to ten percent past its quality cap, with a chance to corrupt it.
beginner.whyItMatters: Jewellery quality is applied through catalysts to a chosen modifier type, so overcapping it sharpens exactly the stat you catalysed for.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it after the piece is already at full catalyst quality and you are happy for its crafting to stop there.

name: Vaal Cultivation Orb
effect: Replaces up to 2 modifiers on a Corrupted Vaal Unique
Replaces other Uniques with a Corrupted Unique of the same Item Class
usage: Right click this item then left click on a unique item to apply it.
description:
Replaces up to 2 modifiers on a Corrupted Vaal Unique
Replaces other Uniques with a Corrupted Unique of the same Item Class

beginner.whatItIs: A stackable orb that replaces up to two modifiers on a corrupted Vaal unique, or turns another unique into a corrupted unique of the same item class.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a way of converting a unique you cannot use into a different one of the same slot, which is otherwise impossible.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on a unique you have no use for, accepting that the result is corrupted and final.

name: Vaal Orb
effect: Modifies an item unpredictably and Corrupts it
usage: Right click this item then left click an item to corrupt it. Corrupted items cannot be modified again.
description: Modifies an item unpredictably and Corrupts it

beginner.whatItIs: A stackable orb that changes an item in an unpredictable way and corrupts it, after which no other currency will work on it.
beginner.whyItMatters: Corruption can add a powerful implicit line or leave the item worse and permanently unchangeable, so it is a one-way door.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on a piece you are willing to lose, or on a finished item where the upside is worth ending its crafting. It drops from level thirty-five.

name: Venerable Starlit Ore
usage: Can be used at the Verisium Anvil to forge a new Unique item.
description: Can be used at the Verisium Anvil to forge a new Unique item.

beginner.whatItIs: A grade of starlit ore spent at the Verisium Anvil to forge a unique item.
beginner.whyItMatters: Each grade is its own drop, so a forging plan can be held up by a single missing ore rather than by currency.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Hold it until the anvil recipe you want calls for this grade specifically.

name: Veridical Starlit Ore
usage: Can be used at the Verisium Anvil to forge a new Unique item.
description: Can be used at the Verisium Anvil to forge a new Unique item.

beginner.whatItIs: A grade of starlit ore consumed at the Verisium Anvil when forging a unique item.
beginner.whyItMatters: Because it occupies a whole inventory slot and cannot be stacked, it is worth knowing what you plan to forge before you carry several.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it to the anvil as part of a forging recipe that names this grade.

name: Verisium
usage: Can be used at the Verisium Anvil to transform Equipment.
description: Can be used at the Verisium Anvil to transform Equipment.

beginner.whatItIs: A stackable metal spent at the Verisium Anvil to transform a piece of equipment.
beginner.whyItMatters: The anvil is a crafting station rather than a click-on-item currency, and verisium is the fuel every transformation there runs on.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it to the anvil when you have equipment worth reworking. It drops from level thirteen and stacks to a thousand, so it accumulates in bulk.

name: Void Flux
effect: Transforms all Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistance modifiers on an item to equivalent Chaos resistance modifiers
usage: Right click this item then left click on a magic or rare item to apply it.
description: Transforms all Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistance modifiers on an item to equivalent Chaos resistance modifiers

beginner.whatItIs: A stackable currency that converts every fire, cold and lightning resistance modifier on an item into chaos resistance.
beginner.whyItMatters: Chaos resistance is difficult to find on ordinary gear, so this turns easy resistances into the one that is hard to source.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it once your elemental resistances are comfortably capped and chaos damage is what keeps killing you. It drops from level sixty-five.

name: Vorana's Crest of the Scythe
usage: Can be used at the Verisium Anvil to transform Unique items.
description: Can be used at the Verisium Anvil to transform Unique items.

beginner.whatItIs: A stackable crest used at the Verisium Anvil to transform unique items.
beginner.whyItMatters: Each crest is its own drop with its own level, so which crests you hold decides which transformations are open to you.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it at the anvil from level twenty-three, on a unique you are not currently wearing.

name: Warding Starlit Ore
usage: Can be used at the Verisium Anvil to forge a new Unique item.
description: Can be used at the Verisium Anvil to forge a new Unique item.

beginner.whatItIs: A grade of starlit ore used in unique item forging at the Verisium Anvil.
beginner.whyItMatters: Ores are the gate on anvil forging, so finding the grade you need is usually what decides when a forge happens.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it to the anvil when the recipe you are working towards asks for the warding grade.

name: Xoph's Catalyst
effect: Adds quality that enhances Fire modifiers on a ring or amulet
Replaces other quality types
usage: Right click this item then left click a ring or amulet to apply it.
description:
Adds quality that enhances Fire modifiers on a ring or amulet
Replaces other quality types

beginner.whatItIs: A stackable catalyst that adds quality to a ring or amulet, enhancing its fire modifiers.
beginner.whyItMatters: It lifts fire damage and fire resistance alike, so it can be an offensive upgrade on one piece and a defensive one on another.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on fire jewellery, or on a ring you are leaning on to cap fire resistance.

name: Yaomac's Orb of Sacrifice
effect: Upgrades a Corruption Enchantment on a Rare Weapon or Quiver and removes a random Modifier
usage: Right click this item then left click on a corrupted item to apply it.
description: Upgrades a Corruption Enchantment on a Rare Weapon or Quiver and removes a random Modifier

beginner.whatItIs: A stackable orb that upgrades the corruption enchantment on a rare weapon or quiver and removes one random modifier.
beginner.whyItMatters: Weapon enchantments feed directly into damage, so the upgrade often outweighs the modifier the orb eats.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on a corrupted weapon whose enchantment matters more to your build than its weakest modifier.

name: Yugul's Orb of Sacrifice
effect: Upgrades a Corruption Enchantment on a Rare Jewel and removes a random Modifier
usage: Right click this item then left click on a corrupted item to apply it.
description: Upgrades a Corruption Enchantment on a Rare Jewel and removes a random Modifier

beginner.whatItIs: A stackable orb that upgrades the corruption enchantment on a rare jewel, deleting one random modifier in the process.
beginner.whyItMatters: Jewels carry few modifiers, so losing one here is a larger share of the item than it would be on a chest piece.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it only when the jewel's enchantment is what you socketed it for.
